g.text: PROVISIONAL CANDIDATES - confirm class hardware before wiring
Native module symbols / named nets / no PCB footprints / Rev P1 / 2026-10-19
Header IDs are J2/J3 positions on Espressif DevKitC V4, not bare-chip pin numbers. Other boards differ.
GPIO34/35/36/39 are inputs only; encoder inputs are translated to 3.3V on sheet 03.
MDD10A controls use sign-magnitude PWM/DIR. No separate driver ENABLE pin is assumed.
RP1 means four independent resistors to GND; it does not implement the unresolved X1 safety power stage.
ESP-local contact/command-loss stops and one final C3/laptop owner remain requirements, not tested firmware.
